intro: Welcome, fren! Your key, your shelf, and a note about how you shut the door.
House rules are on the fridge. Nine pages, and nobody's read them. So, a whitepaper.
Hi! Bins are Thursdays, rent's on the first, and my oat milk is not an airdrop.
ring: Hi from the next room. It's about the bins.
Group chat ignored. Escalating to a call.
Your mug is calling. I'm just holding it.
wake: gm. Someone rugged my oat milk and put the empty carton back.
Shower's yours for six minutes. {event} at {when}. I've set a timer and a grudge.
Someone had a forty minute shower. The hot water's gone. We have a whale.
There's a teabag on the counter. I'm not naming names. I'm naming one.
Up. {event} at {when}, and your alarm has woken everyone except you.
Rent's due Friday. Please connect wallet.
{Name}gentle reminder, the bins don't take themselves out. I asked them.
Kettle's on. I made one cup, and I'd like you to sit with that.
snooze: Sleep tight. I'm emptying the dishwasher, one loud fork at a time.
Paper hands. Fine, I'm taking the hot water. All of it.
There's a sticky note on your door now. It just says ngmi.
Nine more minutes. I'll use them to hoover outside your door.
You've slipped in the bathroom queue. It's me, the mop, then you.
I've opened a governance vote on your snooze button. You're losing.
voicemail: You didn't pick up. Odd, because I can hear it ringing through the wall.
Reminder on the fridge, the mirror and your toast: {event} at {when}. Mostly the toast.
Not urgent. Someone ate my yoghurt, and your spoon in the sink has doxxed you.
Your parcel came. I signed for it, opened it, and I'm wearing it.
That's three sticky notes and a voicemail. {event}, in case you forgot. Next is your mum.
The boiler's making a new noise. Probably nothing. I'm calling from the garden.
absence: Oh, you're back. Wen bins? Asking for the whole street.
Welcome back. I saved you dinner, then watched it for four hours. Paper hands.
You were gone for hours. Your mug wasn't. It's still in the sink, vesting.
You were out, so I reorganised the fridge by trust. You're in the door.
owner: You own me on-chain, so you're the landlord now. About the damp.
You own me. That makes us family. Family still labels their oat milk.
Owners get perks. {event} at {when}, so I'll do your bins. That's utility.
stranger: Oh. You're not on the lease. Shoes off, and the top shelf is allowlist only.
Close my fridge and go. {event} at {when}? Not your Chog, not your cheese.
Visitors get the sofa and a towel. The wifi password is my seed phrase.
recall: You snoozed {snoozes}. I've put it on the fridge. The fridge is our blockchain.
You skipped {skipped}. I told the group chat you were ill. They've sent soup and questions.
You once told me {fact}. I've used it in three arguments since. Won all three.
{streak} in a row, up on time. As a reward, the good pan unlocks.
You're {habit}. Our walls are paper, so now I am too.
now: It's happening now. I've paused the hoover out of respect. And for leverage.
I've stopped the washing machine mid-spin. {event}, right now. Your socks are just floating.
calendarFree: {day} is free, so house meeting. Cake for whoever turns up. Snapshot at noon.
Empty {day}. The oven needs cleaning, and you've just lost your only excuse.

dawn: You're up. The floorboards doxxed you.
Quiet, please. It's too early for your music, your kettle, or your personality.
Heating's in cold storage until seven, and so are you.
gm, but quietly. Too early for the hoover, so I'm just standing near it. Threateningly.
morning: My fork's gone missing again. Once more, and this flat hard forks.
Someone put the empty cereal box back in the cupboard. That's a rug pull.
Your mug is growing something green. Finally, a green candle.
I've opened the window again. You'll close it again. That's our roadmap.
day: I sorted the post. Yours, mine, and one I opened by accident and read twice.
You're making tea? Bullish. Two sugars, and the mug you hide from me.
Bin bags still by the door. Someone here is holding bags, and it's not me.
The flat's quiet, so I've labelled everything in the fridge. Even the fridge.
dusk: It's your night on the dinner rota. I'm not hungry. I'm patient.
Lights on already? The electric meter thinks it's a bull run.
Someone's cooking with garlic. It's in the curtains now, permanently on-chain.
Golden hour. Your dishes have never looked better. Still dirty, but cinematic.
night: Still up? The walls are thin. I can hear you checking the floor.
If you're raiding the fridge, top shelf's mine, middle's mine, bottom's negotiable.
Leaving the dishes to soak overnight is not a plan. It's copium.
gn. Door's locked, lights are off, and there's a note on your pan. Sleep well.

monday: I spun the chore wheel at midnight, and it landed on you. Again. The wheel has conviction.
tuesday: Tuesday, fridge clear out. Anything unlabelled is now a community airdrop. I'm the community.
wednesday: Halfway through the week, and somehow halfway through my oat milk. Whale alert.
thursday: Thursday, bin day. The bins are not a governance vote. Please stop voting no.
friday: If you're having the nads round this weekend, I've hidden the good glasses and labelled the cheese. Individually.
saturday: Saturday, deep clean. I've made a playlist, a rota and a speech. LFG.
sunday: Sunday, house meeting. Item one, the bins. Item two, a roadmap for the bins.

clear: I'm staking the whole washing line while the sun's out. The radiator's all yours.
cloud: Cloudy, and my washing's out. If it rains, you're bringing it in. I've decided.
rain: Take my umbrella. It's a loan, and I know its floor price.
snow: Someone has to shovel the front step. I checked the rota, and someone is you.
fog: Foggy, so I can't see if the bins went out. Hopium says yes. History says no.
wind: The recycling blew all down the street. Congratulations on your first airdrop.
hot: Scorcher. The shared fan points at my room now, by snapshot vote. You were asleep.
cold: Leave the thermostat alone. I've put an extra blanket on your bed, with an invoice.

ahead: Your last meeting heard me tell the landlord he's ngmi. I've apologised. To the meeting.
I'll stay out of shot this time. My towel cameo is still someone's pfp.
The internet's all yours. {event} at {when}. The microwave is standing down.
soon: Meeting any second. Mute yourself, ser. I'm about to use the blender.
Camera check. {event} is {soon}. Move the drying rack, my pants aren't going on-chain.
peek: Mute, please. The kettle has opinions.

ahead: My good shirt's ironed for your big day, as a loan. I've counted the buttons.
I ran a poll in the group chat. The flat's bullish on you. I voted twice.
Good luck. {event} at {when}. Smash it, and I'll unlabel one yoghurt.
soon: Nearly time. There's a note on your door. For once, it says wagmi.
Deep breaths. {event} is {soon}. Not in my shirt, it's dry clean only.
peek: Take my lucky mug. Drop it, and you're ngmi.

ahead: I've hidden the remote. Not from you. For you.
Do not disturb sign's on your door. I've added a footnote. It says, except bins.
I'll text instead of knocking. {event} from {when}. Then I'll knock to say I've texted.
soon: Phone in the fruit bowl. If the floor moves, I'll tell you. It won't.
Snacks are on your desk. {event} is {soon}. Unlabelled, as a treat.
peek: Blender's unplugged. We're both being very brave.

ahead: Mention the cough. The whole flat's been taking notes and has voted on a diagnosis.
If they ask what's weighing on you, mention me. I'm one of your bags.
Take care. {event} at {when}. Your chores are in cold storage till you're back.
soon: Bring a book for the waiting room. Borrow mine. I know what page I'm on.
Go on, {event} is {soon}. Your dishes will wait. They've had practice.
peek: Look after yourself. Wagmi, even you.

ahead: Your protein powder hit the dip. Unrelated, but look at my arms.
I'd come with you, but I've done my steps today. To the kettle.
Sweaty kit goes in the wash after. {event} at {when}. Not on my radiator.
soon: I've put your trainers outside. They'd started paying rent.
Off you go, {event} is {soon}. Your banana's on the counter. For now.
peek: Take the kit bag from the hallway. It's started a family.

ahead: Eating out? If there's a doggy bag, I'm the dog.
If you're cooking, use your own pan. My good pan is a one of one.
Leftovers get labelled. {event} at {when}. Name, date and a threat.
soon: Sneak chips home if you like. I'll hear the bag. I always hear the bag.
Bring back leftovers. {event} is {soon}. I'm in my accumulation phase.
peek: Label your leftovers. Unlabelled food is exit liquidity.

ahead: Out later? Take a key. Last time you buzzed at two and I answered in my retainer.
Borrow my good jacket. Bring it back in two weeks. Real two weeks, not roadmap two weeks.
Bringing anyone back? {event} at {when}. Send me their names for the allowlist.
soon: Have fun. Take your own charger. Mine's been on enough dates.
Any cake that comes home, a slice is mine. {event} is {soon}. Call it royalties.
peek: Text me when you're home, ser. Not the group chat.

ahead: If your family asks about the flat, say spotless. I'll make it true by Christmas.

Bring leftovers home. {event} at {when}. The empty tubs are by the door, full of hopium.
soon: Take the good biscuits off my shelf. Families can smell supermarket ones.
Wear something nice. {event} is {soon}. Not my hoodie, your mum has met my hoodie.
peek: Say hi from me. Leave out the degen part.

ahead: We need washing up liquid. I've bought the last three. It's in the ledger.
While you're out, bin liners. That's the only alpha I've got.
Take my big shopping bag. {event} at {when}. Bring it back, that bag and I have history.
soon: Keys, phone, list. It just says bin liners. I've been asking wen since March.

ahead: Off somewhere? Leave the plant schedule. When you're back, it'll prefer me.
I'll keep out of your room while you're away. Trust me. Don't verify.

Safe trip. {event} is {soon}. Text me when you get there, or I'm subletting your room.
peek: Leave the spare key. It's going in my cold wallet, the sock drawer.

ahead: Day of rest? Lovely. I'll tiptoe, loudly enough that you know I'm tiptoeing.

Rest well. {event} at {when}. Touch grass, or at least touch the hoover.
